display_long_description:
The VR4VET Cloud Engineering VR app simulates a cloud engineering workplace with different tasks to be performed in cloud engineering centre. The users can experience situations representing typical workplaces in a data and cloud engineering center, such as setting up tickets, selecting and replacing hardware components in different server cabinets.

The application can be used as a supplementary material for the end users integrated into the career guidance and vocational education practice. When in the application, the user takes the role of a trainee at a clould engineering center. The user is introduced to the profession and can engage in typical workplace tasks.

The app features:
- Setting up tickets in a cloud engineering center
- Working through different tickets in exchanging and replacing hardware components in a cloud engineering center
- Completing different introduction tours to different hardware components and how to replace them
